summary_for_agent: Customer reports a UPI payment of ₹250 debited from their Kotak bank account 3 days ago (txn_eval_11) but not credited to merchant Urban Kart; status is DEBITED_NOT_CREDITED with failure reason BANK_SWITCH_TIMEOUT. The transaction is 2 days past RBI T+1 TAT, so ₹200 late compensation is due under policy. Auto-refund limit is ₹5,000, so the ₹250 can be auto-reversed and ₹1,000 compensation auto-credited without human approval.
